body: I feel a surge of anger and frustration as the ferry horn sounds, signaling the cancellation of my planned trip. I glance around, noticing the other passengers seem equally annoyed. My mind starts racing with questions and thoughts, as I wonder if the cancellation was due to unforeseen circumstances or the ferry's incompetence. My impulse to confront and demand is strong, but I also know it's essential to approach this calmly and professionally.
